استثمروا (form X)
# اِسْتَثْمَرُوا (istaṯmarū) /is.taθ.ma.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
# اُسْتُثْمِرُوا (ustuṯmirū) /us.tuθ.mi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
# اِسْتَثْمِرُوا (istaṯmirū) /is.taθ.mi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
